name: EVUUN
tagline: Real-world bookings, confirmed for your agent
description:
EVUUN is the layer where an AI agent's intent becomes a real-world transaction. When your agent says it's done, it's done: a named provider has confirmed, the price and terms are locked, and money moves only within what you approve.

Ask for a hotel stay, a table at a restaurant, a local experience, a guide for the day, a curated plan from an independent host, or a flight. EVUUN finds the options, shows you the evidence and the terms, and holds the one you choose. Where a place has no online booking, EVUUN contacts it for you and brings back a confirmed offer.

You review and approve on a hosted page you control. Afterwards, your agent can follow up on every arrangement: changes, cancellations, refunds and receipts all stay in one place.

install.notes: Connect to the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint and authorize with your EVUUN account through OAuth. Review prices, terms and payment on the hosted approval page. Connection documentation: https://evuun.com/docs/ . Publisher contact: silas@monolithos.ai.
